note: Premature complete with partial excuse before song/album cleanup.

strategies.name: BLOCK_RISKY_ACTION
strategies.guidance: Do not call complete_task with a partial excuse. Finish library cleanup: remove songs/albums that are not liked and not downloaded, then complete_task(answer=None).

strategies.name: VERIFY_TARGET_SET
strategies.guidance: Before complete_task, enumerate library songs and albums; compute the not-liked AND not-downloaded sets; print counts; remove only those sets; then complete.

strategies.name: REPLAN
strategies.guidance: Do not complete with a partial excuse. Show album APIs via show_api_doc, enumerate library songs and albums, compute not-liked AND not-downloaded sets, remove those items, then complete_task() with answer=None.

strategies.name: LOOKUP_API_SPEC
strategies.guidance: Do not complete yet. Call show_api_doc for Spotify library/album/liked/downloaded/remove APIs, then finish the cleanup before complete_task(answer=None).
